title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Sixth edition, Volume 6, CHI-Crystallization - EB.11
text: Some say that the Septangint, who made their trans-lation in Egypt, changed the world _China_ has that of Rephans, because they had the same significance. Mr. Basange, in his book entitled _Lorish Goliquitites, after having discovered a good deal upon _Chion_, or _Remphans_, contains that Maledi was the sum, and _Chian, Chium_, or _Remphans_, the moon.
